resources.string: Ride the same route together – everyone on their own trainer, each seeing the others and the gap to them. A room runs on a server of your own, with no account.
To create a room you need a server of your own. Enter it under Settings → Sync with your own server. You can join without one.

Others in the room see your name, where you are on the route and how fast you are riding – your power only if you show it. The server also sees your IP address. You are connected to this server only, and only while the room is open.
First choose a known route under “Routes” that is on your device. Your own rides will not work – only your device knows them.
Paste the link you were sent.
This is not a Trailscape invite link.
This device has a newer version of the route than the room. The host needs to update the route and create a new room.
Your app version does not know this route. Update Trailscape.
Start when everyone is ready. You will find the same button at the start.
The ride is under way. You can join in at any time.
Ready means: at the start with the route loaded.
Anyone with the link can join. It is valid for this room only.
The room ends for everyone. Anyone riding carries on alone.
Connection lost. Trying again in %1$d s. Your place is held for a moment.
The room was closed because nobody was connected any more.
The server ended the room. Create a new one.
This room no longer exists, or the invite link is wrong. Ask for a new link.
Server and app do not match. Update Trailscape or the server.
You are in this room on another device.
Too many failed attempts from your connection. Try again in 15 minutes.
The server refused the connection. Update Trailscape.
No connection to the server. Check your network and join again with the invite link.
The server rejects your token. Check Settings → Sync with your own server.
Your server does not offer rooms. Update it and switch rooms on.
All rooms on your server are taken.
Your server cannot be reached. Check your network.
The room could not be created.
Room ended · you carry on alone
